currentSystem.headUnit: Factory BMW Professional/CD head unit — PLACEHOLDER, confirm exact variant fitted to this VIN
currentSystem.amp: Factory amplifier presence unknown — check for a factory amp module behind trunk trim (Harman/Kardon vs base Hi-Fi vs no amp)
currentSystem.speakers: Factory door/dash/parcel shelf speakers — condition and count unverified
currentSystem.notes: Inspect and document the as-found system before making any upgrade decisions. Many E70 units have a factory amp that can be retained or bypassed depending on chosen tier.

tiers.amp: Retain factory amp if present and functional
tiers.speakers: Clean/service existing speakers, replace any blown units with factory-spec replacements
tiers.wiringNotes: No new wiring required beyond fixing any damaged factory harness sections found during engine bay/interior work.

tiers.headUnit: Retain factory head unit (or add Bluetooth/CarPlay adapter)
tiers.amp: Add compact 4-channel aftermarket amp for front stage
tiers.speakers: Upgrade front door speakers to a quality coaxial or component set
tiers.wiringNotes: Tap factory speaker-level outputs into new amp via line-output converter; run new power/ground/remote wiring to trunk-mounted amp.

tiers.headUnit: Aftermarket head unit with CarPlay/Android Auto (adapter harness required for steering wheel controls)
tiers.amp: 4- or 5-channel amp powering all speakers plus dedicated sub channel
tiers.subwoofer: 10-12in powered enclosure in a sealed box, floor or trunk-mounted
tiers.wiringNotes: Full RCA signal run from head unit to trunk amp, dedicated fused power wire from battery, upgraded ground point.

tiers.headUnit: Aftermarket source unit or DSP-integrated processor retaining factory head unit as source
tiers.amp: Multi-channel amp(s) with active crossover / DSP tuning
tiers.speakers: High-end component set front and rear, dedicated tweeter and midrange staging
tiers.subwoofer: Custom sealed or ported enclosure, matched to cargo-area constraints
tiers.wiringNotes: Full DSP-based signal chain, upgraded electrical (possibly secondary battery/big-3 upgrade), professional tuning recommended.
